description: Swap the kernel to a candidate with pending executions in flight. Compatible persisted state resumes without external effects during reconstruction; incompatible state parks until an approved migration is available.
crash_point: none (control-plane swap at a controlled restart)
expected_observable: State reconstructs by reducer-only replay from history + projection with zero external effects; a compatible candidate resumes pending executions and agrees journal<->projection; an incompatible exec_def/schema version or kernel_meta parks the execution instead of guessing.
